storage.title: Storage / Memory
storage.sub: Local Cursor chat database (state.vscdb). Size check only — never modified while Cursor is open. Backup and compact require Cursor to be fully quit.
storage.warnOver: Above warn threshold ({mb} MB) — consider offline compact after quitting Cursor.
storage.mcpHint: Trial/Pro: enable local MCP memory (archive_session_chunk). Free/Public: storage size + Recent archives only.
storage.mcp.proOnly: MCP memory requires Trial/Pro (activated). Open ready-4-it.com/akc_ccc to upgrade.
storage.compact.confirm: This trims large chat cache entries and compacts the database. Cursor must stay completely closed. Continue?
storage.status.cursorRunning: Cursor is running — quit completely before Backup or Offline compact.
storage.status.cursorQuit: Cursor not detected — Backup / Offline compact can run.
storage.busy.compact: Running offline compact (can take minutes on large DBs)…
storage.ok.compact: Offline compact finished. Restart Cursor when ready.
storage.err.helpers: Storage helper files are missing. Please reinstall the plugin.
storage.err.cursorRunning: Quit Cursor completely first (all Cursor processes), then try again.
storage.err.exit: Hygiene script exited with code {code}. See the PowerShell window for details.
storage.archives.title: CCC archives (read-only)
storage.archives.sub: Search CCC agent_memory.db — not Cursor/VS Code sidebar Unarchive. Enable MCP memory and archive chunks first. Restore in the IDE stays a host feature.
storage.archives.searchPro: Archive search is Trial/Pro. Opening ready-4-it.com/akc_ccc — Free keeps a short Recent list only.
storage.archives.empty: No CCC archive entries yet. Enable MCP memory, then archive_session_chunk / summaries.
storage.archives.missing: Archive viewer is missing. Please reinstall the plugin.
storage.archives.hint: Read-only CCC index. Host Unarchive: Agents sidebar → filter Archived → Unarchive.
storage.quiet.title: Quiet / sleep (deploy & heavy I/O)
storage.quiet.sub: While Quiet is on, the HUD pauses identity polls against Cursor/VS Code databases so Agents typing stays usable during deploys or heavy syncs. The pill shows quiet with a timer.
storage.quiet.auto: Auto-sleep when HUD reads stay slow (opt-in — can add load)
storage.quiet.hint:
Examples: deploy.exe=300  or  deploy.ps1=300  or  WinSCP.exe=180
Match is process name (deploy.exe) or a command-line substring among powershell/pwsh/cmd only (deploy.ps1). Not window title. Leave Auto-sleep off unless needed. Prefs: %USERPROFILE%\.cursor\ccc-hud-quiet-prefs.json
storage.exp.title: Experiments (opt-in)
storage.exp.sub: Default off = stable pill like before. New features (watch, quiet, UIA, glass DB) only when you want to test — they can stutter the desktop.
storage.exp.hint: After changes: restart HUD (Stop → Start). Prefs: %USERPROFILE%\.cursor\ccc-hud-experiments.json
storage.bak.title: Prefs, profiles, and the logo
storage.bak.sub: Export and Import move one JSON anywhere. Save and Load profile keep a named snapshot in the profiles folder and count toward the limit. The logo file is written next to that JSON and put back on restore. Apply still writes the look onto the pill.
storage.help.bak.goal.title: What is saved
storage.help.bak.goal.body: The JSON keeps colors, form, and the logo path. The picture itself is the .logo file beside that JSON. Orbs (Pastell, Metall, 3D, Neon) are restored from that file, or from the built-in art if the copy is missing.
storage.ext.title: Extended (MCP & hygiene)
storage.ext.sub: MCP memory preference (Trial/Pro), backup and offline compact of Cursor state.vscdb — only when Cursor is fully quit.
storage.help.empty: No help text for this tab yet.
storage.ext.recommend: Tip: Quit Cursor completely before Backup or Offline compact. Watch the status line below the buttons.
storage.help.main:
state.vscdb holds Agents chat data. Here: read size, set warn threshold and soft cap, choose archive folder, browse session archives.

Prefs: %USERPROFILE%\.cursor\ccc-memory-prefs.json

Backup/Compact live under Extended — quit Cursor first.
storage.help.exp:
Experiments are off by default (stable pill).

Unlock the master, then enable: HUD watch, Quiet, UIA, glass DB.
Quiet rules (deploy.exe=300) pause identity polls.

Prefs: ccc-hud-experiments.json and ccc-hud-quiet-prefs.json under %USERPROFILE%\.cursor\
After save: HUD Stop → Start.
storage.help.ext:
MCP Memory (Trial/Pro): preference for local session memory.

Backup: copies state.vscdb into the archive folder — only when Cursor is closed.

Offline compact: shrinks the database after Cursor is quit.

Never compact while Cursor is open.
storage.help.main.goal.title: What this tab does
storage.help.main.goal.body: Check state.vscdb size, set a warn threshold, choose an archive folder, and browse session archives. Never compact while Cursor is open.
storage.help.main.defaults.title: Defaults
storage.help.main.defaults.body:
Warn threshold: 2048 MB
Soft cap: 40 (future MCP memory)
Archive folder: ~/.cursor-archive if empty
MCP memory: off (Trial/Pro preference)
Prefs: %USERPROFILE%\.cursor\ccc-memory-prefs.json
storage.help.main.do.title: Daily use
storage.help.main.do.body:
Refresh size occasionally.
Save prefs after changes.
Use Recent archives (Free: short list; Pro: search).
Backup and compact live under Extended — quit Cursor first.
storage.help.main.critical.title: When something feels stuck
storage.help.main.critical.body:
DB far above warn + Agents hangs → Extended tab.
Desktop stutters from HUD → Experimental tab, turn Quiet/UIA off, HUD Stop → Start.
storage.help.main.steps.title: Offline compact (Extended)
storage.help.main.steps.body:
1) Quit Cursor (tray until no Cursor.exe)
2) Extended → Offline compact
3) Restart Cursor when done
storage.help.exp.goal.title: What experiments are
storage.help.exp.goal.body:
Watch + Glass keep the pill on the right Agents project (on by default).
Quiet and UIA are the risky switches — enable only on purpose.
storage.help.exp.defaults.title: Defaults
storage.help.exp.defaults.body:
Experiments master: off
Watch + Glass: on (identity)
Quiet + UIA: off
Files: ccc-hud-experiments.json, ccc-hud-quiet-prefs.json
storage.help.exp.do.title: When to touch this
storage.help.exp.do.body:
Daily use: leave master off — Watch/Glass still run.
Quiet only with concrete rules (e.g. deploy.exe=300).
UIA only briefly — often freezes the desktop.
storage.help.exp.critical.title: If IDE stutters
storage.help.exp.critical.body:
IDE stutters with HUD → Quiet/UIA off, save prefs, HUD Stop → Start.
Leave Quiet Auto-sleep off — it adds load itself.
storage.help.exp.steps.title: After changes
storage.help.exp.steps.body:
Save prefs on the tab.
HUD Stop → Start.
storage.help.ext.goal.title: Extended / hygiene
storage.help.ext.goal.body: MCP memory preference (Trial/Pro), backup and offline compact of state.vscdb — only when Cursor is fully quit.
storage.help.ext.defaults.title: Safety rules
storage.help.ext.defaults.body:
Backup copies state.vscdb to your archive folder.
Offline compact shrinks the chat database.
CCC refuses both while any Cursor process is running.
storage.help.ext.do.title: Recommended flow
storage.help.ext.do.body:
Check status line (running vs quit).
Backup first when DB is huge.
Compact only after quit; can take minutes.
Restart Cursor after compact.
storage.help.ext.critical.title: Never do this
storage.help.ext.critical.body: Never compact while Cursor is open — that can damage the chat database.
storage.help.ext.steps.title: Compact steps
storage.help.ext.steps.body:
1) Quit Cursor completely
2) Extended → Offline compact → confirm
3) Wait for OK status
4) Start Cursor again
help.drawer.look.title: Look
help.drawer.look.body: The box model is the layer sketch. The mini preview is the pill. Color and form are chosen here, and Apply writes them onto the pill. Icon and logo are the other Settings control.
help.drawer.logo.title: Icon and logo
help.drawer.logo.body: Pastell, Metall, 3D, and Neon replace the icon. A custom logo stays until overwrite is checked. Export and profiles on Storage → Backup save the logo file beside the JSON.
help.drawer.storage.title: Cursor storage
help.drawer.storage.body: state.vscdb holds Agents chat data. This tab reads the size, the warn threshold, and the archive folder. Copying or compacting that database is on Extended, and only after Cursor has quit.
help.drawer.backup.title: Prefs and profiles
help.drawer.backup.body: Export moves one JSON file wherever you choose. Save profile keeps a named copy in the profiles folder and counts toward the cap. The logo file is written beside the JSON and comes back on import or load.
help.drawer.experiments.title: Experiments
help.drawer.experiments.body: Watch and Glass keep the pill on the selected Agents chat. Quiet and UIA stay off unless you turn them on. After a change, stop the HUD and start it again.
help.drawer.hygiene.title: Database backup
help.drawer.hygiene.body: Backup now copies state.vscdb. Offline compact shrinks the database. Both only run when Cursor is completely closed.
help.drawer.activate.title: Free to Pro
help.drawer.activate.body: Get CCC Pro at ready-4-it.com/akc_ccc, install the licensed package, then activate here with your device hash and activation key (R4IT…).
help.drawer.about.title: Updates
help.drawer.about.body: Click Check for updates to download and install a new version directly. On first use, the HUD asks once for network permission.
help.topic.overview.title: Overview
help.topic.overview.body:
AI Keep Clean Context Control Center (CCC) gives every project in Cursor and VS Code Agents a clear visual identity.

The floating Pill on the screen edge shows your active project with its own label, colors, shape, and logo. Double-click the Pill to open Settings.

All look settings, logos, and profiles are stored locally on your machine — no cloud account needed for daily work.
help.topic.start.title: HUD, pill & start
help.topic.start.body:
There are three ways to start the Project HUD:

1) VS Code extension (AKC CCC VS)
Open Context Control Center and click Activate. By default, the extension also starts the HUD automatically with VS Code.

2) Windows login autostart (Trial & Pro)
Enable “Start HUD with Windows” under Settings and click Apply. The Pill then starts automatically when you sign in to Windows.

3) Manual start / stop
If the Pill is not running yet, you can also start or stop it using the copyable terminal commands under Language & start.
help.topic.nav.title: Navigation
help.topic.nav.body:
The HUD window has five sections at the top:

Settings — Pill colors, shape, box model, icon/pattern, and custom logo.

Storage — Database size check, settings/profile backup, optional experiments, and offline database cleanup.

Activation — Device hash, online activation, and your R4IT activation key.

Help — Short guides for every feature.

About — Version, edition, and one-click update check.

Top-right in the bar: contextual Help for the current page and the HUD language switcher.
help.topic.scope.title: Scope & saving
help.topic.scope.body:
Under Settings you choose the scope:

Project (default) saves only for the project currently selected in Agents. This is the usual path when several repositories need different looks.

Global is the fallback when a project has no own prefs yet. At runtime the pill uses project prefs first, then Global, then built-in defaults.

Apply writes the values and updates the pill. Reset restores the state from when the dialog was opened. Without Apply, dialog changes are lost when you close.
help.topic.look.title: Look, presets & logo
help.topic.look.body:
The box model shows the layers of the Pill, and the mini preview shows the result right away. Click Apply to write changes onto the live Pill.

Colors and 3D forms can be combined freely (Pastel, Metal, Studio, Neon with Flat, Cube, Extrude, Glass, or Sphere).

Logos & Orbs (Trial/Pro): Pick a built-in Orb or browse for your own logo (PNG, JPG, BMP, GIF, ICO, WebP — up to 2 MB and 2048×2048). To replace an active custom logo with an Orb, check “Overwrite custom logos if present”.
help.topic.storage.title: Storage & hygiene
help.topic.storage.body:
Cursor stores chat history locally in state.vscdb. When that file grows to several gigabytes, switching projects can feel sluggish.

The Storage page has four tabs:
• Storage — Check the current database size, set a warning threshold (default 2048 MB), and pick a backup folder.
• Backup — Export or import your look settings (including the logo) or save named profiles.
• Experimental — Optional switches such as Quiet mode during heavy builds/deploys ( pauses background checks so typing stays smooth ).
• Extended — Create a database backup or run Offline compact to shrink state.vscdb.

Important: Quit Cursor completely (including tray icons) before running Backup or Offline compact.
help.topic.activate.title: Free → Pro
help.topic.activate.body:
One device activation covers both Cursor and VS Code on this computer.

How to activate Trial or Pro:

1. Purchase CCC Pro at ready-4-it.com/akc_ccc and download the licensed package.

2. Open Activation in the HUD and click Open online activation (your device hash is included).

3. Enter your shop purchase key on the website to receive your R4IT… activation key.

4. Paste the R4IT… key into the HUD and click Use activation key.

Note: AI Keep Clean (AKC) and AKC CCC are separate products with separate keys.
help.topic.prefs.title: Prefs & profiles
help.topic.prefs.body:
Under Storage → Backup (Pro) you can export and import your settings as a JSON file, or save named snapshots as profiles. Your custom logo is saved alongside automatically and restored on import or load.

The number of saved profiles and custom logos depends on your edition (Free, Trial, or Pro).

When you open a new project for the first time, CCC assigns a stable icon automatically — you can customize it anytime under Settings.
help.topic.hudops.title: Language, autostart & start/stop
help.topic.hudops.body:
HUD language

Use the language switcher at the top right. System GUI follows your Windows display language (with English as fallback), or pick a fixed language. The dialog reopens immediately in the chosen language.

Autostart with Windows (Trial & Pro)

Check “Start HUD with Windows” under Settings and click Apply. Uncheck and click Apply to turn it off again.

Manual start / stop

Use the tabs below to copy ready-to-run start and stop commands for your terminal.
help.copy.hostNote: Tip: Usually you start the HUD via AKC CCC VS → Activate or Windows Autostart. The commands below are an optional terminal fallback.
help.topic.privacy.title: Privacy
help.topic.privacy.body:
CCC reads the local Cursor selection (local Agents chat selection on this machine) to map the active chat to the workspace. That is how the pill knows which project is meant.

HUD prefs, position, license, and assets stay under %USERPROFILE%\.cursor\ (ccc-*.json and ccc-hud-assets). CCC needs no cloud for everyday use.

Licensed delivery (Trial / Pro)

• Purchase and checkout: ready-4-it.com (Payhip flow). Binding terms are shown at checkout.
• Online activation: ready-4-it.com receives your device hash (derived locally from machine id, platform, hostname, and a local salt in ccc-hud-device.json) plus your purchase license key to issue a signed CCC token (R4IT…).
• In-app updates (About → Check for updates): your R4IT token, installed Agents version, and module id akc_ccc are sent to Streaming Zebra at api.streamingzebra.com — a ready-4-it delivery service for entitled downloads (short-lived redeem URLs, not public GitHub).
• Zebra does not receive your Cursor password or chat content.
• One Streaming Zebra network consent (HUD prefs) covers only licensed contacts to api.streamingzebra.com (Trial/Pro: install, update check, download, uninstall). Revocable anytime.

Free / Public (freemium)

• Counting goes through Alveos Beacon (login.alveos.eu), not Streaming Zebra. The report is install id, event (install, usage, update, uninstall), version, client type, and platform. No license key. The Zebra consent does not cover this count.
• Plugin files still come from GitHub and the Marketplace. The VS Code Free VSIX is a separate companion and does not deliver an Agents package.

Legal / privacy: ready-4-it.com/privacy · streamingzebra.com/privacy · streamingzebra.com/terms · support@ready-4-it.com · Product: ready-4-it.com/akc_ccc · Delivery: streamingzebra.com
